challenge_alignment.trigger: First Comparator run on P011-submit-ready-r3 (official verify_entry.sh in PalomarVerify, 2026-09-25): the seven MAFComposition and DegradationControl selected statements matched; AutocatalyticCS.sourceDirectCSCoreEnum_exact did not ("Challenge and solution theorem statement do not match").
challenge_alignment.diagnosis: A dependency-closure dump (names, universe parameters, type and value hashes) of both environments showed that the Challenge re-typed the source definitions verbatim, but (1) six private IndexedMatching helpers get module-specific private names, (2) auto-bound universe names differed because the Challenge placed all AutocatalyticCS definitions in one variable scope, and (3) Lean's module-local match/sparse-casesOn caches made Challenge definitions reuse auxiliary constants created earlier in the same file (e.g. MAFComposition.blockColumns._sparseCasesOn_1), where each source module creates its own.

source_changes.change: Eight IndexedMatching helpers (leftEmbedding, rightEmbedding, left/rightRangeEquiv, left/rightIndexEquiv, left/rightIndex_symm_val) made public; `set_option backward.match.sparseCases false in` on forwardEdges and backwardEdges. No statement changed. This file is also in the P003 closure; the frozen P003 checkout is unaffected.

`set_option backward.match.sparseCases false in` on reactantGraph and IndexedMatching.subgraph; subgraph.verts written as Sum.elim instead of a match (definitionally the same predicate), so it no longer shares a matcher with sourceExchangeNext.

challenge_change.change: The AutocatalyticCS block was re-scoped into one namespace block per source module (Basic, FiniteMinimality, DirectPathPack, SourceSemantics, SourceGraphBridge, CycleToggle, and the core/enumeration modules), with the same variable declarations and opens, the same public helper names and the same options. A second Comparator run on the resulting candidate matched all eight statements and then reported "Const does not match" for MAFComposition.Network.priceCone: the column calculus (weightedColumn, StrictObstruction, parallelColumns, singletonColumn) is universe-polymorphic in DualCalculus.lean but was fixed to Type in the Challenge; those four definitions now sit in their own block with the source variables {ι κ ρ : Type*} [Fintype ι]. Definition and theorem text is otherwise unchanged; the DegradationControl block is byte-identical. 680 -> 724 lines.
